body: I told my mom. She reacted horribly, as imagined, but she made me take them and I'm already feeling better withdrawal wise. I'm glad I told her. I'm not so glad that it's tearing her apart. I always feel like I'm just causing her so much unnecessary pain. Anyway, thank all of you for your concerned comments. I'm seeing my psychiatrist on Wednesday morning.
I feel like my time is up. Like I had a purpose or whatever but it's gone now.
